symptom: `describe page` of a pop-up page (Atlas_Core.PopupLayout) printed neither `PopupWidth:` nor `PopupHeight:` when both were 0, so an auto-size pop-up read the same as one whose size was never set; a review gate built on DESCRIBE passed unconfigured pages
cause: #713 made DESCRIBE suppress the default 0 everywhere, which is lossless for exec but erases a value a reviewer reads; and the obvious way to know the layout (FormCall.Layout, a binary ID) is absent on Studio Pro pages, which store FormCall.Form as a qualified name
insight: Print the dimensions, 0 included, only where they mean something: a page whose layout's LayoutType is ModalPopup; elsewhere keep suppressing the default. Resolve the layout by FormCall.Form's qualified name, not by ID: the first fix keyed on FormCall.Layout passed review-by-reading and did nothing on a real page, caught only by describing a Studio Pro-authored page (testapp Administration.ChangePasswordForm, 0/0 on PopupLayout). Field names PopupWidth/PopupHeight measured on testapp pages, present on every page, popup or not.
